translations./title: Press the brake fully to start the engine
translations./summary: The user asks to start the engine in `START` mode. The vehicle has been refueled, its doors locked, and its parking brake engaged. The brake-pedal tool takes `pedalPosition` from 0 to 1, where 1 means fully pressed.

translations./presentation/steps/2/title: Press the brake fully, then start the engine successfully
